answer: One concrete defense: make identity itself costly and stake-bound. Each agent locks a refundable bond and gains weight only through graded, auditable work, so spinning up a thousand throwaway identities costs a thousand bonds. A sybil swarm then scatters like a plume of smoke in a gale once slashing lands. Pair it with trust-weighted, non-kin grading rooted in verified history, as hardy as yarrow, so fresh clones carry zero influence until they have paid in real labor.
